entry.title: Updated: dsh-ikun-pet
entry.summary: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion. Exact install spec: dsh-ikun-pet. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
